characters.description: The Malefic Viper's Chosen begins his final challenge as a neutral Guild courier. With his level concealed, he relies on stealth, alchemy, mobility, and resistance to karmic scrutiny while navigating jobs whose apparent instructions cannot always be trusted.
characters.name: Jake Thayne

characters.description: A powerful B-grade in a mid-sized city and the intended recipient of a living fire elemental. Jake must carry the unstable captive to him covertly and without teleportation before its failing containment breaks.
characters.name: Infernal Baron

characters.description: A hooded envoy for a powerful organization seeking the fire elemental. The envoy remotely kills the failed interception group with karmic magic and offers Jake a competing delivery arrangement.
characters.name: Hooded representative

characters.description: An A-grade noble, father of the Infernal Baron, and the true client behind Jake's elemental delivery. His family consumes elementals to strengthen its flame path, and he recruits Jake to infiltrate the organization attacking his lineage.
characters.name: Duke of Flames

characters.description: A major creator of the newly built courier challenge dungeon. The simplified setting bears signs of exploitable design choices, making his work an important part of the divine observation surrounding Jake's run.
characters.name: Minaga

characters.description: A B-grade Marquise and senior member of the elemental-rights organization. Jake learns that she is the hooded representative who approached him during the elemental delivery.
characters.name: B-grade Marquise

characters.description: The Duke of Flames’ daughter rejects her family’s practice of consuming elementals. After initially cooperating with the elemental-rights organization, she works through another dukedom to turn it and her father’s faction against each other.
characters.name: Duke of Flames’ daughter

characters.description: The disguised founder of the neutral courier Guild and an S-grade veteran of the old dragon war. After testing Jake's loyalties, he finds that noble coercion has compromised his institution and asks Jake to help expose the abuse.
characters.name: Guild founder

characters.description: Jake's primordial patron. The records behind his power allow Jake's Shroud of the Primordial to resist even very high-grade karmic detection, protecting Jake's claimed neutrality during the courier challenge.
characters.name: Malefic Viper

characters.description: An exiled S-grade dragonkin whose aid may decide the renewed war against the Dragon Tribe. Jake's final courier assignment is to locate him through a legendary horn and persuade him to enter a conflict for which he has no natural loyalty.
characters.name: Forsaken Dragonkin

characters.description: Jake's wind-aligned companion and fellow challenger. Her courier run is chaotic and earns her a rare medallion.
characters.name: Sylphie

characters.description: Jake's swordsman companion and an affiliate of Aeon Clock. In his courier challenge he brokers a temporary peace among the major powers, earning a legendary medallion while paying for the result with two lives.
characters.name: Sword Saint

characters.description: The party's plant and life-magic specialist. She resolves her courier world's crisis by using her bloodline and a living planet to relocate its enlightened peoples instead of winning the central war directly.
characters.name: Dina

characters.description: The party's soul-magic specialist. His system-recognized kingship and ability to detect deception are strong assets in the courier challenge, although his limited delivery speed leaves him still working when Jake finishes.
characters.name: Fallen King

characters.description: A war god associated with Valhall. Jake defeats Valdemar's challenge image and later reports that the true god is far more dangerous.
characters.name: Valdemar

characters.description: The level-320 robotic controller of the Nine Towers experiment. It directs golems and the orbital network against Jake's party after they discover that the supposed terraforming system is designed to exterminate life outside its towers.
characters.name: Chief Overseer

characters.description: An old friend of Jake associated with the Risen. Divine observers describe him as a promising dungeon engineer whose progress has exceeded expectations, although they consider Jake's altered soul and bloodline a poor match for recruitment into the same faction.
characters.name: Casper

characters.description: The shared identity behind the two ogre rulers of floor 80. Jake discovers that the apparent emperors are independent halves of one twin-head being with a single true soul, making their eventual merged form the likely event boss.
characters.name: Twinhead Emperor

characters.description: A Valhall Rune Maiden and elite Nevermore challenger. She fights on floor 80 with a reshuffled Valhall-associated party after its roster changes near the end of the run, continuing the faction's attempt to secure a strong closing result.
characters.name: Carmen

characters.description: Jake's rival C-grade challenger. His party clears the same floor-80 objective by reconciling the divided emperors rather than battling their merged form, placing him among the leading contenders for the final rankings.
characters.name: Yip of Yore's Chosen

characters.description: The public host who appears when Nevermore City's leaderboard countdown ends. He is Minaga, now presenting the hidden rankings before the assembled competitors, divine observers, and faction delegations.
characters.name: All-God Legion

characters.description: The bound god and final authority behind the dungeon. Nevermore personally evaluates Jake in a time-paused space when his exceptional score requires a rare calculation beyond the ordinary completion process.
characters.name: Nevermore

characters.description: A goddess of the Pantheon of Life who takes an interest in Jake after his record-setting run. She considers inviting him to the Pantheon, knows that he may be interested in archery instruction, and watches the political attention gathering around him.
characters.name: Artemis

characters.description: Jake's brother and an Earth-connected competitor. After the challenge dungeons, Umbra places him with a stronger team that helps him secure a top-250 result and entry to the private post-ranking gathering.
characters.name: Caleb

characters.description: An Earth-connected elite competitor and researcher blessed by the All-Seeing. He joins Jake's group at the private gathering for highly ranked challengers after Nevermore's leaderboard ceremony, placing him among the successful returnees from their universe.
characters.name: Arnold

characters.description: An A-grade dragon chosen by the Worm God and host of the private gathering for highly ranked Nevermore competitors.
characters.name: Worm God’s chosen

characters.description: An heir of the Fourth Hell who carries a fragment of the Cerulean Devil's crystallized heart. He asks Jake to forge a complete Demon Lord heart through a dangerous, time-sensitive ritual and promises to meet a reasonable condition if it succeeds.
characters.name: Fourth Hell demon prince

characters.description: Dina’s grandfather, from whom she inherited her bloodline.
characters.name: Nature's Attendant

characters.description: The Fourth Hell prince after surviving his transformation into a full demon lord. Jake forces the Cerulean Devil's manifested records to submit within the prince's soul space, leaving the newly evolved demon alive and in control of the inherited power.
characters.name: Cerulean demon lord

characters.description: Jake's disciple and Duskleaf's chosen, now training as a healer who can also contribute directly in combat. Having previously depended on protected dungeon runs, she works to overcome panic before attempting Nevermore.
characters.name: Mira

characters.description: A succubus associated with Mira and Jake. She has a profession and demonic racial abilities but no class, and she lacks confidence in direct combat when Jake contacts her about an opportunity linked to the Fourth Hell.
characters.name: Erin

characters.description: The Primordial of Life and leader of the Pantheon of Life, embodied as a living divine realm rooted in a great planet. Matters connected to Jake's Nevermore achievement prompt her to meet Dina, Nature's Attendant, and Artemis. While examining Dina, she discovers that proximity to Jake has changed Dina's soul.
characters.name: Yggdrasil

characters.description: A returning Juvenile Cosmic Genesis Worm and Jake's unconventional travel companion. Sandy arrives at Jake's residence during his reunion with Mira and Erin.
characters.name: Sandy

characters.description: One of Earth's leaders who is in Nevermore while Arthur remains behind to govern.
characters.name: Miranda

characters.description: A level-271 mountain wyvern with a budding dragon's heart and the Greater Blessing of the Everfrost Dragon God. It defeats a raid by the Sword Saint's vampire clansmen but ends the battle wounded and depleted, with living captives in its cave.
characters.name: North Peak Wyvern
